candidates.reason: Primary test file for scrapy.utils.response.open_in_browser. It contains the two ReDoS regression tests that are flaky (timed against the hardcoded 0.2s CPU budget in the shared _assert_open_in_browser_is_fast helper) and the exploit bodies under change, including the comment body whose trailing b'<!---->' supplies the closing '-->' so the removed '<!--.*?-->' pattern matches early. It also holds every base-tag injection, comment-preservation, .txt and TypeError assertion that must stay green.

Only end-to-end coverage of open_in_browser: scrapy/commands/view.py calls it, and TestViewCommand runs the real command against a local mock server with a recorded browser script, asserting the rendered temp file and the non-text error path. It is the integration safety net if the injected base tag or response handling changes while fixing the ReDoS tests.
